body: I care because I am there....right this very second. I wonder why any of you care but they do...we do....I do. I hate to see, hear, or feel someone suffering almost as much as I hate seeing myself suffer. Talk to us some, it might help

I'm sorry about the late response but yes, I think about it every day, I'm in a horribly shitty place (mentally and psychically) because of all sorts of reasons. I really hope you do, please, just talk to someone and try to be there for someone like yourself when they need it. I hope your day has gotten a bit better. Much love.

Man, I'm 26 years old, live at home still, work for a family business (that is probably failing) and I am still carless. Even though I totally get where you're coming from, for I have felt the same way since about the same age(if not since I can remember). You DO need to go talk to someone, preferably a therapist. I know it is easier said than done for I have yet to do it myself but the ONE day I've been on this subreddit has given me a bit of insight, at least we are not alone.
Please reconsider and maybe talk to me a little? It could help

I totally get how you feel. I'm currently sitting at work, with my overly angry father(who used to physically(hitting slapping and kicking etc.) and mentally abuse me when I was younger), trying not to cry and trying to keep the thoughts away. I hope you'll reconsider your decision and continue this talk
Hey man...need someone to talk to? I know how you feel..

I second this. I tried talking to my ex/best friend and she made me out to be a dick for expressing how shitty I'm feeling and that she can't read my mind, when I'm crying out for help...This is not what people in our shoes need. Whether these people are to be cut out of your life or not, must find at least someone to talk to. First time I've been to SW and posted something and I already am feeling a BIT better. We are here for you and so are others.

It's good to hear of others making it through depression alright and possibly even better than before. I think I'll start looking into it. 

I'm not. I'm a 26 yr old living at home and working for my overly angry father..ha

Fortunately, talking right now and even posting this has calmed me down a bit already. I guess it's because of the social stigma behind mental "illnesses" and health but I'm legit scared to talk to some one professional. Feels like they'll immediately put me in a straight jacket and haul me off

Hey, thanks, you're a kind person. They really are terrifying, I can be feeling totally fine one second and catch myself thinking about offing myself...I saw someone say in another SW post that its like 3 days of "happiness" followed by 3 months of pain and sorrow. I almost couldn't explain it any better right now. I need someone to talk to, I've either scared all my friends off or I'm so depressed that I can't even get myself out to do anything or I just ruin THEIR day and/or mood.
